recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: parser combinators resurfacing in late-night code threads
clear autumn night over the bay at thirteen degrees
sunset closing in on golden gate fog
agents spinning up from a pocket-sized shortcut

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling syntax tokens and snap them into valid parse trees before the compiler window closes — each completed tree compiles with a satisfying thunk.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to link matching brackets and operators
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: watching a broken expression resolve into clean compiled output in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: tokens fall faster, nested brackets multiply, invalid connections flash red
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: terminal phosphor green on deep black

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Steer a micron-scale probe through circuit pathways, threading gaps narrower than a hair while collecting precision samples.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: hold and slide to adjust probe angle and drift
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each successful junction unlocks an electron-microscope snapshot of the route
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: pathways narrow, vibration jitter increases, junctions fork unpredictably
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: electron microscope grayscale with false-color junction highlights

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Paint fog ribbons across the bay skyline before sunrise — rhythm taps synced to wind gusts, golden hour multiplier when the pattern matches the silhouette.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: tap on beat, hold for sustained fog strokes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: a single round captures one perfect autumn dawn over the water
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind shifts tempo, competing fog layers drift across lanes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor dusk with muted orange horizon bleed

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick agent helpers from your phone onto a living blueprint — each completes a micro-task before the shipping-by-sunrise countdown hits zero.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick outward to launch agents, tap to recall and reroute
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: cascading task completions chain into one clean ship moment
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more tasks spawn mid-round, agents need routing coordination to avoid collisions
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: cyanprint blueprint with hand-drawn annotation marks
